# ex: matchSelectorExpr with method expression (type.Method)
ex {
	var x T
	x.Do() -> x.Do2()
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{}

func (T) Do()  {}
func (T) Do2() {}

func f() {
	var t T
	t.Do()

	fn := T.Do
	_ = fn
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@

 func f() {
 	var t T
-	t.Do()
+	t.Do2()

 	fn := T.Do
 	_ = fn
